text.text_excerpt: You know on my first ever trip to St. Roch Market I just had to try the Mexican place they have here. La Mezcla has a nice selection of goodies such as tacos and enchiladas. but today I was in the mood for a taco salad with pork. I went up and ordered, gave the guy my name and waited as he made my food fresh. The salad was packed with pork, cheese, lettuce, tomato and onions all in a crispy shell with jalapeño dressing on the side . I couldn't wait to dig in. The ingredients of this bowl are resh and crispy, and the pork is so juicy that I really didn't even need the dressing and only ended up using a little of it. Such a fan. I come here at least once a month. Normally for the chicken taco salad with jalepeno ranch dressing. Seasoning is so on point with the meats that I overlook the crazy ratio of lettuce to meat in the salad. When you look at it you are like "this is a lot of lettuce" but somehow it works itself out in the mouth. The bowls are crispy without being greasy. I also love the subtly of the dressing. I normally eat the inside first without the dressing and then eat the bowl piece by piece dipping it in the dressing. My SO and I came here looking for some new and decent tex-mex. And we were pretty pleased with our decision. I got a taco salad with pork carnitas. The shell was nice and crisp, the pork was juicy and flavorful, and it was a good amount for the price. My only issue was that it wasn't that busy, but it seemed to take forever to get our food. Maybe there were more people around than I thought, but it just seemed to take too long. Still good tho.
